subject: Ironbridge Systems — evidence handoff & artifact staging plan
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@ironbridge.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Natalie Chen <natalie.chen@ironbridge.com>, procurement@ironbridge.com
Date: 2027-04-25T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Ironbridge SIG package — synchronization and timeline

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the annotated SIG you sent earlier — that was helpful. As we start our procurement sprint next week, we need to get a tight handoff plan for the remaining artifacts (evidence exports, key control owners, and scope confirmations). Our security team has asked for a staged delivery so they can run an internal review in parallel with legal.

High-level asks from Ironbridge:
- A mapping file that ties Redwood controls to SIG control IDs and the evidence filename(s)
- A single manifest (Excel) listing all artifacts and their retention/location
- A short delta note listing any controls that are Not Applicable or require customer attestations

Can you confirm who on your side will be the day-to-day point for artifact uploads and whether you can deliver the initial bundle by Friday (2027-04-30)? Also please call out any artifacts that are export-only (logs/audit trails) that will require scoped access.

Thanks,
Samir
Information Security Manager
Ironbridge Systems

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@ironbridge.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Ironbridge SIG package — synchronization and timeline

Samir —

Appreciate the clear asks. Proposed plan below (short and actionable):

1) Owners & cadence
   - Day-to-day upload + manifest owner: Olga Petrov (security intake) — will push artifacts to a shared Drive folder and notify you.
   - Evidence validations / control clarifications: Neha Kapoor (Security) — technical clarifications and pointer to runtime logs.
   - Control mapping and SIG spreadsheet annotations: Karthik Iyer (Compliance) — delivers the CSV/annotated SIG.

2) Deliverables and ETA
   - Control mapping (CSV): RBW_control_mapping_v1.csv — draft by 2027-04-29 EOD PT.
   - Artifact manifest (Excel): artifact_manifest_20270429.xlsx — by 2027-04-29 EOD PT.
   - Annotated SIG PDF: sig-questionnaire-redwood-annotated.pdf — by 2027-04-30 AM PT.

3) Notes on export-only artifacts
   - Long-term audit logs (30/90 day slices): will be exported as compressed CSVs; delivery requires temporary read-only storage access.
   - Live KMS access proofs: screenshots and audit traces only — we do not share key material.

4) Security & access
   - We will create a Drive folder and share with Ironbridge security and procurement. If you prefer SFTP, we can provide that as well.

If that schedule works, I will post the Drive link and attach the draft CSV by Thursday morning so you can begin validation.

Best,
Olga
Senior Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@ironbridge.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-27T11:23:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Ironbridge SIG package — synchronization and timeline

Samir / Olga — quick clarifications from the mapping side so we avoid churn: 

- Scope: Are you requesting only the hosted API surface (prod/replay logs) or also Dedicated/Private deployment docs? Please confirm production scope (prod-redwood-hosted) or include other environment names.
- Evidence format preference: CSV (column-per-control) vs. single annotated SIG PDF. I can produce both but would like to know which your reviewers prefer.

I'll call out a few controls that typically need customer confirmation (example: user provisioning for private deployments). For those I will mark NA or "requires customer attestation" in the CSV.

If you can confirm scope by EOD, I will lock the mapping and push the RBW_control_mapping_v1.csv to the shared Drive.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@ironbridge.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Ironbridge SIG package — synchronization and timeline

Samir —

Confirming the plan and adding the artifact delivery notes: 

- Scope confirmed: production-hosted only ("prod-redwood-hosted"). We will not include Dedicated/Private artifacts unless you request them expressly.
- Artifact staging: I created the Drive folder and added a placeholder manifest. Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_cedar_manifest (shared with your natalie.chen@ironbridge.com and procurement@ironbridge.com).
- Initial artifact list uploaded (placeholders):
   * access_control_policies.pdf (policy excerpts)
   * infra_inventory_202704.csv (asset inventory export)
   * audit_log_snapshot_202703-04-2027.zip (redacted) — export-only, will need a temporary download token.
   * RBW_control_mapping_v1.csv (mapping, draft)

- Timing: Initial bundle (mapping + manifest + placeholders) uploaded 2027-04-29 09:42 PT. Full annotated SIG PDF to follow by 2027-04-30 AM.

Action items for Ironbridge: please confirm who on your side should receive temporary download tokens for the export-only artifacts (we recommend one technical reviewer + one procurement contact). Also please confirm whether you require signed SOW before we hand over long-format logs (DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/Signing/?s=IB-2027-045-SOW).

Neha
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@ironbridge.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Ironbridge SIG package — synchronization and timeline

Thanks, team — that looks good. Natalie will be our technical reviewer (natalie.chen@ironbridge.com) and procurement@ironbridge.com will handle SOW review. Please provision the download token for audit_log_snapshot_202703-04-2027.zip to natalie.chen@ironbridge.com only.

We will review the Drive folder this afternoon and set up a 30-minute sync with your team tomorrow morning to walk through the mapping and call out any gaps. Proposed sync: 2027-04-30 09:00 PT. Invite will come from procurement@ironbridge.com.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Samir
Information Security Manager
Ironbridge Systems
